fabrication_sequence: set the polygon effector and locate sleeve/pin stations
wind CFRP around the sleeve stations and cure the resin
remove temporary tooling; retain sleeves bonded into the CFRP edge
align sleeve pairs of adjacent modules and pass a steel bolt through them
